hypothesis: A deterministic whole-block energy combining forward and reverse statistics can identify exact blocks from fewer transmitted syndrome bits than causal coding while retaining full-depth exact fallback.
kill_condition: Retire v1 if its exact archive is not smaller than the matched causal control, reverse energy does not improve over forward-only inference, or bounded decoding exceeds the declared candidate search budget.
promotion_condition: Exact roundtrip and deterministic replay beat the matched causal control after depth, syndrome, finalization, and source cost, with positive page-disjoint holdout transfer and bounded decode search.
title: MOIRAI rateless whole-block syndrome inference
